verdict.rationale: Neon docs explicitly cover 'Instant restore' for branches and reset/restore branch tooling is corroborated by the MCP tool surface ('reset/restore branches', 'Finalize branch restore from snapshot') and by a community report of periodically resetting a branch to its parent in production use. missing for 10: a first-party CLI/API code example walking through the exact reset-to-parent command and independent hands-on verification beyond the one community comment.
